summary: Researchers developed a novel catalyst enabling oxidative coupling of methane at lower temperatures while maintaining sustained performance.

title: Wildfire smoke forces school closures in Manaus, Brazil
summary: Hundreds of wildfires blanketed Manaus, the Amazon's largest city, with smoke severe enough to close public schools during an intensifying El Niño event.

title: Anthropic's Claude enzyme discovery raises questions about AI use of existing research
summary: A biologist questioned whether Anthropic's Claude AI system may have incorporated existing unpublished work when discovering an unusual enzyme family.

title: Study finds strength training shrinks fat cells in mice within seven days
summary: Seven days of strength training sessions in obese mice triggered shrinkage of visceral fat cells and reactivated fat-burning molecular pathways without overall weight loss.

title: Powerful waves from Tropical Storm Rachel damage California coast
summary: Tropical Storm Rachel brought heavy waves that damaged homes and caused flooding along Southern California's coast.

title: Post-tropical cyclone Isaias weakens after Florida landfall
summary: Hurricane Isaias weakened to a post-tropical cyclone after making landfall in northwestern Florida with heavy rain and strong winds.

title: Nearly 300,000 people at risk from Himalayan floods as development accelerates in flood zones
summary: A Scientific Reports study reveals that approximately 300,000 people in Nepal, India, and China face flood risk in Himalayan areas, with building in vulnerable zones increasing by 45% in recent years.

title: Childhood exercise adapts bodies for easier adult fitness, guinea fowl study suggests
summary: Research on guinea fowl reveals that early physical activity during development may reduce exercise difficulty later in life.

title: Vanillin Compound Shows Potential for Infection Fighting and Wound Healing
summary: Scientists discovered that vanillin, the compound giving vanilla its flavor, has antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties that could advance wound healing and infection treatment.
